title: Regulation library entry
description: Structured representation of a single regulation (or regulation series), as consumed by the article_loader and rendered by the document viewer. See docs/plans/2026-09-11-de-rag-evidence-spec.md §3.1.

id.description: Stable regulation identifier. Same id appears in KB anchors (`regulation_id`).

official_citation.description: Display citation as a compliance practitioner would write it (e.g. 'Regulation (EU) 2023/1542').

source_url.description: Official source URL (public laws/regulations). Required for public; null otherwise.

purchase_url.description: Purchase / lookup URL for private standards (ASTM, UL, GB, EN, etc.). Required for private; null otherwise.

consolidated_version_url.description: If a consolidated (post-amendment) version exists, link to it here.

replaces.description: Earlier regulation IDs superseded by this one.

replaced_by.description: If this regulation has been formally repealed, the successor's ID.

language.description: ISO 639-1 (or BCP-47) code for the article text language. en / zh / fr etc.

source_kind.description: Provenance tier of the article texts (plan 2026-09-14 J08 / §4.4 layer 3). official_verbatim = verbatim text from the official source (may enter the exact-quote flow); official_summary = faithful summary of the official text; curated_summary = internal KB-derived summary, usable for candidate retrieval but must NOT be presented as verbatim; private_summary = paid private standard (GB/UL/ASTM/EN/AS) with only KB summary; unverified = placeholder/condensed text pending verification — never claim as 原文.

raw_file.description: Relative path (under data/regulations/) to the official PDF/HTML file, or null for private standards.

notes.description: Free-form maintenance notes (amendments applied, structure decisions, etc.).

id.description: Article ID within this regulation (e.g. 'art-77', 'annex-iv', '第17条', '工信部无[2021]129号'). Non-whitespace only — no semantic constraint to allow Chinese punctuation and brackets.

text.description: Full article text. Empty/missing is allowed only as a placeholder (need_human_review).
